cohort: The study included 400 women who delivered vaginally or by caesarean section and were counselled for IUCD insertion either pre-natally or during labour.
finding: Acceptance of PPIUCD was significantly higher among women from urban localities, those with higher parity, and those who delivered by caesarean section, while less educated, lower-class, and unemployed women showed lower acceptance.
mod_finding: Women who delivered by caesarean section were significantly more likely to accept PPIUCD compared to those with vaginal deliveries.
cross-section timing: Initial assessment of IUCD acceptance occurred immediately postpartum, with follow-up on safety conducted at six weeks postpartum.
